environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no managed rule groups attached). The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic on port 80 to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/lib/app/. No additional request filtering or input validation middleware is configured. The application runs as ec2-user with standard filesystem permissions.

config.alb: internet-facing, default listener rules, no WAF association
config.instance: t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, security group allows inbound 80/443
